reference: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md §§24,44-46,94
scope_note: Implementation is not yet wired to Coordinator or HTTP harness; integration contracts are reported as gates.

findings.title: Missing or empty sidecar is silently treated as a new chain during reopen
findings.recommendation: Split first-time exclusive creation from reopen-existing; missing/empty sidecar during restart/recovery must fail closed. Sync the parent directory on first creation and inject the verified handle/identity.

findings.title: Commit result attempt number is not consistently checked and attempt 2 terminal_failed is rejected
findings.recommendation: Track the active commit attempt and require exact result attempt_no; permit terminal_failed after attempt 2 when valid. Add Append/replay tests for valid and mismatched outcomes.

findings.title: terminal_failed may omit already-established plan_hmac and bundle_hmac
findings.recommendation: Require every event after plan_ready/bundle_ready, including terminal_failed, to carry the same known HMAC; permit null only before those values exist.

findings.title: Append can grow JSONL beyond the replay limit and report success for an unreopenable file
findings.recommendation: Enforce total-size limit before writing and define a durable terminal/seal policy for exhausted capacity.

findings.title: Single-writer OS lifecycle lock and OpenVerified handle/ACL boundary are external and not yet integrated
findings.recommendation: Before Coordinator/harness integration, prove a supervisor-owned cross-process case lock spans child lifetime, or add sidecar OS locking; pass verified handles/identity rather than reopening by path. Verify Windows ACLs outside the current permissive helper.
